thetotalwater-soluble sulphatecontentof theconcrete

silica may be susceptible to attack by alkalis (N~O

Damage to

b) A cement withhigh alkali content, or another

c) Aggregate containing an alkali reactive

aggregate reaction, no furtherprecautions should be
